scenes.title: Cold open
on_screen: Title card: Kaosikii dance · India · 20th century (1978)

scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The dance was invented on September 6, 1978, by Prabhat Ranjan Sarkar (Shrii Shrii Anandamurti).
It was further explained in a speech titled 'The Cosmic Father Has a Special Responsibility' in Madras on December 4, 1978.

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: The dance is intended to cultivate mysticism and establish a link between the finite and the infinite.
It is used to develop mental stamina, strength, self-confidence, and self-expression.
Today it is a living tradition.

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: The dance is described as a psycho-physical exercise.
While specific step-by-step mechanics are not fully detailed in the sources, it is known to involve rhythmic movement designed to develop the 'koshas' or layers of the mind.
scenes.music: diegetic (the video's own sound), underscore under narration

scenes.title: Listen
narration: The sound is defined by the repetitive chanting of the 'Baba Nam Kevalam' mantra, providing a steady rhythmic pulse for the physical movements.
